title: Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers — Holding Several Credits
content:
**Condition.** A customer may hold any number of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers, of any instrument, at the same time. There is no maximum number of credits per customer.

**Condition.** Each credit is a separate record with its own credit number, its own value and its own expiry date. Credits are never merged into one another.

## What the two conditions mean for a credit holder

| Circumstance | Result under the conditions |
|---|---|
| A customer holds a Crestline Flight Credit and receives a Crestline Disruption Voucher | Both are held at the same time, each under its own number |
| A customer holds three Crestline Trip Credits | All three are held; there is no limit on how many credits one customer holds |
| A customer holding two credits asks for their values to be joined | The credits stay separate; credits are never merged into one another |
| Two credits of one customer carry different expiry dates | Each keeps its own expiry date |

## Hypothetical case

A customer holds a Crestline Flight Credit worth 180.00 US dollars that expires in March and a Crestline Trip Credit worth 95.00 US dollars that expires in October. Under the conditions these remain two credits: 180.00 expiring in March and 95.00 expiring in October. They do not become one credit of 275.00 with a single expiry date. The amounts and months are examples only.
